instructions: A fundamental bicep builder that targets the Biceps and Forearms through elbow flexion. The machine provides stability and a fixed path of motion, perfect for isolating the muscle safely. The support eliminates momentum, forcing pure isolation of the muscle. The neutral grip targets the brachialis and forearms while reducing wrist strain. Essential for developing arm size and pulling strength. 1. Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding the machines with a secure grip. 2. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and palms facing your body (neutral grip). 3. Contract your biceps to curl the weight up, keeping your upper arms stationary. 4. Squeeze your biceps hard at the peak of the movement. 5. Lower the weight slowly, resisting gravity until your arms are fully extended. 6. Maintain constant tension on the muscle and avoid using momentum.

instructions: A powerhouse posterior chain exercise hitting the Glutes, Hamstrings, Lats and Lower Back. The machine provides stability and a fixed path of motion, perfect for isolating the muscle safely. Builds total body strength and real-world power. 1. name: Seated Leg Press (Machine)
instructions: The premier lower body builder, targeting the Glutes, Hamstrings and Quads and core. The machine provides stability and a fixed path of motion, perfect for isolating the muscle safely. The seated position eliminates body momentum, isolating the target muscle strictly. Fundamental for leg size, strength, and athletic power. 1. Sit securely in the machine, adjusting the seat height so the handles align with your glutes. 2. Place your feet on the platform shoulder-width apart and release the safety handles. 3. Push through your heels to extend your legs, avoiding locking your knees at the top. 4. Squeeze your glutes hard at the peak of the movement. 5. Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position with full control. 6. Keep your wrists straight and strong throughout the lift.
